answer: Use interaction-graph conductance screening against Sybil attacks. A new identity starts on probation and gains full rights only after interaction with many established identities outside its cluster over weeks. Honest users form a wide graph, like a river crossing ground, while fakes cluster tightly, linked to each other, like a closed canyon cut off from the tundra. The system measures conductance, the share of links reaching outside a cluster, and quarantines low-conductance clusters. An attacker must forge many cross-cluster ties per fake identity, paying time and social effort each time.
